Brands page content not read

license.name: Tanner Supply Co.
license.registry: Michigan LARA licensee search (aca-prod.accela.com/MILARA), not run; Bedford Township (Monroe County) building department: no official contractor registration page found
license.note: Per its website (checked 2026-11-20), Tanner Supply Co. is a commercial distributor in Temperance, MI of doors, frames, hardware, toilet partitions and washroom accessories. It calls itself the authorized area distributor for toilet partitions. The site mentions installation only for hardware ('Hardware Sales, Installation & Service'). It does not say the company installs partitions, and it lists no license numbers. Company phone: 734.847.5446; the site also lists 419.847.5446. Michigan has no state license for commercial interior work such as partition installation: LARA licenses only residential builders and maintenance and alteration contractors (MCL 339.2401 et seq., residential scope; see research/state-licensing/states.json). For that reason I did not run a state license lookup. The LARA Accela licensee search is public and needs no sign-in, but it is a postback form that automated fetching can't query. One web search found no official Bedford Township (Temperance) contractor registration page. Some nearby Michigan townships, such as Northfield and Sumpter, require contractors to register before they get permits, so registration with Bedford Township may be needed before permitted work. Confirm by phone with the township building department. The Toledo area's Ohio rules don't apply to this Michigan-based business unless it works in Ohio.
